segment.source: All shall perish in a wave of mutating death!<end>
segment.target: All shall perish in a wave of mutating death!<end>

segment.source: Repent now or suffer for all eternity!<end>
segment.target: Repent now or suffer for all eternity!<end>

segment.source: Crawlers! Up there! Look! ::He points at the ceiling.::<end>
segment.target: Crawlers! Up there! Look! ::He points at the ceiling.::<end>

segment.source: Listen to me, my $(#son/daughter) - ye be a sinner!<end>
segment.target: Listen to me, my $(#son/daughter) - ye be a sinner!<end>

segment.source: Salvation lies in the Church of Tchort!<end>
segment.target: Salvation lies in the Church of Tchort!<end>

segment.source: Evelyn Ingram shall dissolve eternally for her blasphemy. The magnificent eye of Tchort sees everything!<end>
segment.target: Evelyn Ingram shall dissolve eternally for her blasphemy. The magnificent eye of Tchort sees everything!<end>

segment.source: Tchort will once again set his minions loose upon the non-believers!<end>
segment.target: Tchort will once again set his minions loose upon the non-believers!<end>

segment.source: Tchort loves you all! Except maybe Bryan. No one likes Bryan.<end>
segment.target: Tchort loves you all! Except maybe Bryan. No one likes Bryan.<end>

segment.source: I used to be like you, Tchortless and hollow. Now, I look forward to walking the Surface and turning into a new, better man.<end>
segment.target: I used to be like you, Tchortless and hollow. Now, I look forward to walking the Surface and turning into a new, better man.<end>

segment.source: If you denounce Tchort... you *will* suffer!<end>
segment.target: If you denounce Tchort... you *will* suffer!<end>

segment.source: All blasphemers shall be sucked into the darkest caverns and absorbed, for they have denounced our one and only savior!<end>
segment.target: All blasphemers shall be sucked into the darkest caverns and absorbed, for they have denounced our one and only savior!<end>

segment.source: The plaguebringers may appear defeated, but they'll be back. Mark my words! They'll be *back*!<end>
segment.target: The plaguebringers may appear defeated, but they'll be back. Mark my words! They'll be *back*!<end>
